about.text: To amend the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to make it a felony offense for any person who is seeking to be a candidate in an election for Federal office or an employee or agent of such a person to knowingly fraudulently sign any materials or documentation required to be filed as a condition of ballot access for such election, and for other purposes.

actions.text: Referred to the Committee on House Administration, and in addition to the Committee on the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

effective.note: Not enacted as of the date of the data (stage reached: Introduced). A bill becomes law only when both chambers pass the same text and the President signs it, lets it become law without a signature, or is overridden. It has no effective date.
